title: Cookies & Tracking Policy
html:
Cookie & Tracking Policy

Effective Date: 23 September 2026

This Cookie & Tracking Policy explains how DECIPHER INVESTMENT ADVISORS LLP, operating as Decipher Investments (“Decipher”, “we”, “us” or “our”), uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit:

https://www.decipherinvestments.com/

This Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains more broadly how we collect, use, disclose, retain and protect personal information.

1. What Are Cookies and Similar Technologies?

Cookies are small pieces of information that websites may store on your browser or device.

Websites may also use other technologies that perform similar functions, including scripts, tags, pixels, local storage and other browser or device-based technologies.

These technologies can be used for purposes such as:

  • enabling essential website functionality;
  • maintaining security;
  • remembering certain choices;
  • understanding how visitors interact with a website; and
  • measuring website performance.

In this Policy, we refer to cookies and these similar technologies collectively as “cookies and tracking technologies.”

2. Technologies Used on Our Website

Our website is operated using Squarespace.

Our current documented website technology stack also includes:

  • Google Tag Manager, which is used to manage website tags; and
  • Google Analytics 4, which is used for website analytics.

The particular cookies or technical identifiers generated by a service may depend on the provider’s current technology, configuration and browser environment.

We therefore describe our use of these technologies by provider, category and purpose rather than listing unverified cookie names.

3. Categories of Technologies We Use

A. Strictly Necessary Technologies

Strictly necessary technologies are used where they are required for the website to operate properly, provide functionality requested by a visitor, maintain security or support essential website functions.

Our website platform, Squarespace, may use necessary technologies as part of operating and delivering the website.

Where a technology is genuinely necessary for the website or a service requested by you, it may operate without an optional analytics choice where permitted by applicable law.

Strictly necessary technologies cannot be disabled through our analytics preference control where disabling them would prevent the relevant necessary function from operating.

B. Analytics Technologies

We use Google Analytics 4 to help us understand how visitors interact with our website.

Analytics information may help us understand matters such as:

  • website usage;
  • page visits;
  • navigation through the website;
  • general interaction patterns;
  • website performance; and
  • how we can improve our website and its content.

Google Analytics is implemented through Google Tag Manager.

For visitors to whom our consent-based controls apply, Google Analytics is treated as a non-essential technology and is disabled unless the visitor chooses to allow Analytics.

4. Google Tag Manager

We use Google Tag Manager, a service provided by Google, to manage the deployment and operation of website tags.

Google Tag Manager functions as part of our tag-management architecture.

The fact that Google Tag Manager is present does not mean that every possible Google or third-party advertising or analytics service is used.

Only technologies that form part of our approved website configuration should be activated through the container.

Where a tag is subject to a consent requirement under our configuration, the relevant tag must remain blocked until the required choice has been made.

5. Google Analytics 4

We use Google Analytics 4 (“GA4”), provided by Google, for website analytics.

GA4 may process technical and usage information relating to website interactions when Analytics has been permitted to operate.

Depending on configuration and browser circumstances, this may include information such as:

  • website and page interactions;
  • session information;
  • browser and device characteristics;
  • referral information;
  • approximate geographic information derived from technical information; and
  • analytics identifiers.

We use this information to understand website usage and improve our website.

We do not use analytics consent as consent for unrelated marketing.

6. Our Consent Approach

For visitors in regions where we apply prior-consent controls to non-essential analytics, including our current configuration for visitors in the European Economic Area and United Kingdom, Analytics is disabled before a valid choice is made.

Our intended configuration follows a Basic Consent Mode approach for Google Analytics.

This means that, for the consent-controlled Analytics category:

  • GA4 should not activate before the required consent;
  • analytics cookies should not be created before consent;
  • analytics measurement data should not be transmitted to Google before consent;
  • rejecting non-essential technologies must leave Analytics disabled; and
  • Analytics may activate only after the visitor chooses to allow it.

Our consent interface provides the following principal choices:

Accept All

Allows the optional Analytics category.

Reject Non-Essential

Keeps optional Analytics technologies disabled.

Manage Preferences

Allows the visitor to review and manage available categories before making or changing a choice.

The website should remain available where a visitor rejects optional Analytics technologies.

7. Cookie Preferences

You can manage your cookie and tracking preferences through the Cookie Preferences control available on our website.

Our current preference structure includes:

Strictly Necessary

Status: Always Active where genuinely necessary

These technologies support essential website operation, security or requested functionality.

Analytics

Default: Off where prior-consent controls apply

This category includes Google Analytics 4.

You may choose whether to allow Analytics.

If you do not allow Analytics, or if you reject non-essential technologies, GA4 remains disabled under the applicable consent-controlled configuration.

8. Changing or Withdrawing Your Choice

You may change your cookie preferences after making an initial choice.

To do so, use the Cookie Preferences link available through the website.

If you previously allowed Analytics and later withdraw that permission, our consent configuration is intended to:

  • update your Analytics preference;
  • prevent future consent-dependent GA4 collection; and
  • preserve an appropriate record that your preference was changed.

Withdrawal does not retroactively alter processing that lawfully occurred before your preference was changed.

9. Records of Cookie Choices

Where appropriate, we may retain information necessary to demonstrate and administer your cookie preferences.

A consent or preference record may contain information such as:

  • whether optional Analytics was accepted or rejected;
  • the date and time of the choice;
  • the relevant consent category;
  • the version of the cookie interface;
  • the version of this Cookie & Tracking Policy;
  • the applicable regional configuration; and
  • a session, browser or pseudonymous identifier used to associate the preference with the relevant browsing context.

These records are used to operate your preferences and maintain appropriate evidence of the choices presented and made.

10. Squarespace Technologies

Our website is built and operated through Squarespace.

Squarespace may use cookies and similar technologies to provide website functionality, security, platform services and other functions associated with operating the website.

Some Squarespace technologies may qualify as necessary for particular website functions, while other technologies or integrations may require a visitor choice depending on their purpose, configuration and applicable law.

We configure our website privacy controls so that non-essential technologies covered by our consent configuration are restricted as appropriate.

Because Squarespace features and cookie configurations may change over time, the precise technical identifiers used by Squarespace may also change.

Each provider may process information under its own applicable privacy and data-processing terms.

For further information about how personal information is handled in connection with these services, please review our Privacy Policy and the privacy information published by the relevant provider.

12. Advertising and Targeting Technologies

Our current documented consent configuration is focused on necessary website technologies and Analytics.

Advertising, retargeting or similar technologies must not be added to the website without first assessing:

  • their purpose;
  • information collected;
  • provider;
  • applicable consent or opt-out requirements;
  • required preference-center category;
  • impact on this Policy; and
  • whether additional privacy disclosures are required.

If we introduce additional categories of tracking technology, we will update our website controls and this Policy as appropriate.

13. Browser and Device Controls

Most browsers provide controls that allow you to view, block or delete cookies.

Browser settings operate separately from our website’s Cookie Preferences control.

Blocking all cookies through your browser may affect website functionality, including functions that rely on necessary technologies.

Where our website provides a consent or preference mechanism, using your browser settings does not prevent you from also using that website mechanism.

14. Global Visitors

Decipher is established in India and its website may be accessed internationally.

Requirements relating to cookies and tracking technologies differ between jurisdictions.

We may therefore apply different technical defaults or consent requirements depending on factors such as:

  • applicable law;
  • visitor region;
  • technology category; and
  • the purpose for which a technology is used.

Where our configuration requires prior consent for Analytics, Analytics remains disabled until the required permission is obtained.

15. European Economic Area Visitors

For visitors for whom applicable European rules require prior permission for a particular non-essential storage or access technology, we use consent-based controls for the relevant technology.

Under our current configuration, GA4 Analytics is treated as consent-controlled for applicable EEA visitors.

You may accept, reject or manage the Analytics category through our cookie interface and may later change your preference.

16. United Kingdom Visitors

For UK visitors, we operate our website tracking controls in accordance with our selected consent configuration and applicable UK requirements concerning cookies and other storage and access technologies.

Under our current website configuration, we choose to place GA4 Analytics behind the Analytics choice for UK visitors.

This operational choice applies even where a particular use of storage or access technology may potentially qualify for a statutory exception under applicable UK rules.

You may reject optional Analytics or change your choice through Cookie Preferences.

17. Changes to Our Technology Stack

Our website technology may change over time.

Before materially adding or changing a non-essential analytics, advertising, tracking, social-media or similar technology, we intend to assess its:

  • purpose;
  • category;
  • data use;
  • provider;
  • consent dependency;
  • jurisdictional impact; and
  • required disclosure.

Where a new technology materially affects this Policy or your choices, we will update the Policy and our preference controls as appropriate.

18. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie & Tracking Policy when:

  • our website technologies change;
  • our analytics configuration changes;
  • we add or remove service providers;
  • the purposes for which technologies are used change;
  • applicable legal requirements change; or
  • an update is otherwise required to maintain accurate information.

The updated Policy will display a revised effective or last-updated date.

Where required, a material change may also result in a new cookie choice being requested.
